findings.detail: check_artifact_budget raises 'R476 artifact budget exceeded' (line 545) with the round hardcoded in the message even though the module is shared across R476/R477; R477's budget phase would mislabel its own round in a failure message. Cosmetic only - threshold and fail-closed behavior are round-agnostic.

The documented --resume recovery path appends '--resume' to the runner argv, but R470-family runners (including run_r477_u2_confirmatory.py) parse exactly [command, shard_id] and exit 2 on the unknown flag, so a driver-level resume of failed shards cannot work as documented. Pre-existing shared infra and off the R477 frozen success path (the pipeline never passes --resume and aborts fail-closed on a failed wave); advisory only.
